name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a **2px solid focus ring, inset 1px from the element**, with a **4.5:1 contrast ratio** against the background.

This ensures keyboard users see clear focus without disrupting layout, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility. The inset keeps the ring from overlapping adjacent elements, avoiding accidental clicks on mobile. Trade-off: the ring may feel subtle to some, but it balances visibility and design integrity.

name: Reader
text: A 2px inset ring risks being missed on high-DPI or low-contrast screens—WCAG 2.2 AA requires 3:1 minimum for focus indicators, and 4.5:1 is safer. A **3px solid focus ring, outset 1px**, with 4.5:1 contrast against the background meets both visibility and layout safety without relying on inset tricks. Test with Playwright MCP’s screen-reader mode to confirm it’s reachable and not obscured.
